issues.explanation: Chapter 119 says Sima Zhao had stationed troops at Chang'an because he feared Wei Guan could not capture Deng Ai. The source says he feared Zhong Hui (the司徒) might fail to capture Deng Ai. This misattributes Zhao's operational concern and weakens the ensuing handoff into Zhong Hui suspecting he is being watched.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the sentence to: “司马昭因恐钟会不能擒邓艾，已屯兵长安。”
